title: Sparse specification manifest
description: Tracked-portable sparse Markdown identity manifest, stored under .vcs-lab/specs/ beside its source document (src/specs.js serializeSpecManifest). Blocks are re-derived from the canonical Markdown on read; vlab spec show --json returns the materialized view, which adds sourceBytes, sourceLines, and blocks.

source.description: Repository-relative path of the canonical Markdown document.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 of the LF-normalized source document.

sourceBlob.description: Git blob identity of the normalized source; enables index-blob cache hits. Optional.

idOverrides.description: Semantic key to entity-ID overrides that preserve identity across renames; keys sorted.
